'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|The Thirsty dude? You too?! Why are you all bringing him up all of a sudden? Yeah, I worked with this guy. Couldn't last five minutes without a drink. We made some good money with him back then. Always brought good loot, that guy. My respect to him. But he's been out of the game for a long time, at least in Tarkov. I can give you a tip on where he dumped his extra supplies, but not for free. I'm looking for two tanks of propane right now. Why don't you find it for me, and then we'll talk about your guy?}}

==Objectives==
* Find 2 [[Propane tank (5L)|Propane tanks (5L)]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Propane tank (5L)|items]]

==Rewards==
* +9,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.01'''</font>
* 200 Euros
** 210 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 230 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Expeditionary fuel tank]]
{{quote|You got it? That's a good start. Now we can talk about Thirsty.}}
